statements: CREATE TABLE tenants (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','suspended')) DEFAULT 'active');
CREATE TABLE identities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, issuer TEXT NOT NULL, external_sub TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(issuer,external_sub));

CREATE TABLE memberships (tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id), role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','admin','member','viewer')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')) DEFAULT 'active', PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,identity_id));

CREATE TABLE price_catalog (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), grant_units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(grant_units>0), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)) DEFAULT 0, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

CREATE TABLE orders (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id), price_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES price_catalog(id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), currency TEXT NOT NULL, grant_units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(grant_units>0), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','settled','void')) DEFAULT 'pending', client_key TEXT NOT NULL, provider_checkout_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(tenant_id,client_key), UNIQUE(provider_checkout_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,identity_id) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_order_tenant ON orders(id,tenant_id);

CREATE TABLE provider_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, provider TEXT NOT NULL, provider_transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('settlement','refund')), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), currency TEXT NOT NULL, verified_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(provider,provider_transaction_id,kind));

CREATE TABLE credit_ledger (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), delta INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(delta!=0), source_key TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT REFERENCES provider_events(event_id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(tenant_id,source_key));
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_tenant ON credit_ledger(tenant_id);

CREATE TABLE holds (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), work_id TEXT, request_key TEXT NOT NULL, units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(units>0), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('open','committed','released')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(tenant_id,request_key), FOREIGN KEY(work_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES work(id,tenant_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_hold_tenant_state ON holds(tenant_id,state);

CREATE TABLE invoices (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), order_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id), currency TEXT NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), tax_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tax_review_required', issued_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(order_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES orders(id,tenant_id));

CREATE TABLE refund_requests (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id), identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), reason TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('requested','rejected','provider_pending','settled')) DEFAULT 'requested', client_key TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES provider_events(event_id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(tenant_id,client_key), FOREIGN KEY(order_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES orders(id,tenant_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,identity_id) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id));

CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, objective TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,created_by) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_project_tenant ON projects(id,tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_project_tenant ON projects(tenant_id);

CREATE TABLE work (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, desired_outcome TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('draft','approved','running','verified','blocked')) DEFAULT 'draft', created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(project_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES projects(id,tenant_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,created_by) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_work_tenant ON work(id,tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_work_project ON work(tenant_id,project_id);

CREATE TABLE agents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), work_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work(id), principal TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, budget_units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(budget_units>=0), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive' CHECK(status IN ('inactive','active','revoked')), FOREIGN KEY(work_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES work(id,tenant_id));

CREATE TABLE artifacts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), work_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, storage_ref TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_verified' CHECK(evidence_state IN ('not_verified','verified')), FOREIGN KEY(work_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES work(id,tenant_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_artifact_evidence_scope ON artifacts(id,work_id,tenant_id);

CREATE TABLE evidence (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id), work_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work(id), artifact_id TEXT REFERENCES artifacts(id), claim TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, verifier_subject TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(work_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES work(id,tenant_id), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id,work_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES artifacts(id,work_id,tenant_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_evidence_work ON evidence(tenant_id,work_id);
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_credit_ledger_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_credit_ledger'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_credit_ledger_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_credit_ledger'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_provider_event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON provider_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_provider_event'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_provider_event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON provider_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_provider_event'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_invoice_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_invoice'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_invoice_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_invoice'); END;

CREATE TABLE enrollment_evidence (
  proof_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL, external_sub_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, verifier_identity TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,identity_id) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id)
);
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_enrollment_evidence_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON enrollment_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_enrollment_evidence'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER axiom_enrollment_evidence_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON enrollment_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_enrollment_evidence'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_order_economics_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON orders
WHEN OLD.id!=NEW.id OR OLD.tenant_id!=NEW.tenant_id OR OLD.identity_id!=NEW.identity_id
 OR OLD.price_id!=NEW.price_id OR OLD.amount_minor!=NEW.amount_minor
 OR OLD.currency!=NEW.currency OR OLD.grant_units!=NEW.grant_units
 OR OLD.client_key!=NEW.client_key OR OLD.created_at!=NEW.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'order_economics_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_refund_request_economics_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON refund_requests
WHEN OLD.id!=NEW.id OR OLD.tenant_id!=NEW.tenant_id OR OLD.order_id!=NEW.order_id
 OR OLD.identity_id!=NEW.identity_id OR OLD.amount_minor!=NEW.amount_minor
 OR OLD.reason!=NEW.reason OR OLD.client_key!=NEW.client_key
 OR OLD.created_at!=NEW.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'refund_economics_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_refund_terminal_state_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF state,event_id ON refund_requests
WHEN NOT (
 (OLD.state=NEW.state AND OLD.event_id IS NEW.event_id)
 OR (OLD.state='requested' AND NEW.state IN ('provider_pending','rejected') AND NEW.event_id IS NULL)
 OR (OLD.state='provider_pending' AND NEW.state='rejected' AND NEW.event_id IS NULL)
 OR (OLD.state='provider_pending' AND NEW.state='settled' AND OLD.event_id IS NULL AND NEW.event_id IS NOT NULL)
) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'refund_terminal_state_immutable'); END;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_axiom_provider_event_credit_once
ON credit_ledger(event_id) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_provider_credit_amount_guard BEFORE INSERT ON credit_ledger
WHEN NEW.event_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM provider_events e JOIN orders o ON o.id=e.order_id
 WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id AND o.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
 AND ((e.kind='settlement' AND NEW.delta=o.grant_units)
   OR (e.kind='refund' AND NEW.delta<0))
) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'provider_credit_amount_mismatch'); END;

CREATE TABLE canonical_customer_links (
 identity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
 tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
 customer_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')),
 link_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(link_kind IN ('fresh','legacy')),
 proof_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 proof_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proof_sha256)=64),
 consent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 authority_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,identity_id) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id)
);

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_canonical_link_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON canonical_customer_links
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM canonical_customer_links p WHERE p.identity_id=NEW.identity_id
 OR p.customer_id=NEW.customer_id OR p.proof_id=NEW.proof_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'canonical_link_insert_conflict'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_canonical_link_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON canonical_customer_links
WHEN OLD.identity_id IS NOT NEW.identity_id OR OLD.tenant_id IS NOT NEW.tenant_id
 OR OLD.customer_id IS NOT NEW.customer_id OR OLD.link_kind IS NOT NEW.link_kind
 OR OLD.proof_id IS NOT NEW.proof_id OR OLD.proof_sha256 IS NOT NEW.proof_sha256
 OR OLD.consent_id IS NOT NEW.consent_id OR OLD.authority_subject IS NOT NEW.authority_subject
 OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'canonical_link_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER axiom_canonical_link_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON canonical_customer_links
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'canonical_link_immutable'); END;

CREATE TABLE customer_cases (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
 identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
 client_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('support','privacy_export','privacy_delete')),
 subject TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(subject) BETWEEN 4 AND 160),
 detail TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(detail) BETWEEN 8 AND 3000),
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested' CHECK(status IN ('requested','under_review','resolved','denied')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 UNIQUE(tenant_id,identity_id,client_key),
 FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,identity_id) REFERENCES memberships(tenant_id,identity_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_cases_pending_right ON customer_cases(tenant_id,identity_id,kind)
 WHERE kind IN ('privacy_export','privacy_delete') AND status IN ('requested','under_review');
CREATE INDEX customer_cases_tenant_owner ON customer_cases(tenant_id,identity_id,created_at);
CREATE TRIGGER customer_cases_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON customer_cases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'customer_request_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER customer_cases_no_rewrite BEFORE UPDATE OF tenant_id,identity_id,client_key,kind,subject,detail,created_at ON customer_cases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'customer_request_immutable'); END;

CREATE TABLE customer_idp_flows_v1 (
 state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_hash)=64),
 browser_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(browser_hash)=64),
 sealed_payload TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at_ms>created_at_ms),
 used_at_ms INTEGER,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','processing','complete','failed')),
 CHECK((status='pending' AND used_at_ms IS NULL) OR (status!='pending' AND used_at_ms IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE customer_idp_sessions_v1 (
 session_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(session_hash)=64),
 flow_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES customer_idp_flows_v1(state_hash),
 issuer TEXT NOT NULL,subject TEXT NOT NULL,
 auth_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at_ms>created_at_ms AND auth_time_ms<=created_at_ms),
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')),
 session_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(session_version>0)
);

CREATE TRIGGER customer_idp_flow_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF state_hash,browser_hash,sealed_payload,created_at_ms,expires_at_ms ON customer_idp_flows_v1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idp_flow_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER customer_idp_flow_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status,used_at_ms ON customer_idp_flows_v1
WHEN NOT ((OLD.status='pending' AND NEW.status='processing' AND OLD.used_at_ms IS NULL AND NEW.used_at_ms IS NOT NULL)
 OR (OLD.status='processing' AND NEW.status IN ('complete','failed') AND NEW.used_at_ms=OLD.used_at_ms))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idp_flow_transition_denied'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER customer_idp_flow_delete BEFORE DELETE ON customer_idp_flows_v1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idp_flow_delete_denied'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER customer_idp_session_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF session_hash,flow_hash,issuer,subject,auth_time_ms,created_at_ms,expires_at_ms ON customer_idp_sessions_v1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idp_session_immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER customer_idp_session_delete BEFORE DELETE ON customer_idp_sessions_v1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idp_session_delete_denied'); END;
